question: If MOANA is written as 132 in a particular code language, how will CROOD be written as in that language?
solution:
The positional value of alphabets are as follows

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf650c01d4e041b18cf1732a47c42f4c1415f2128aeef953723baf0cd6b18f46.png] 

Here, the following logic is used

**Code = (sum of the positional values of the alphabets) × 3**
